name: groweasy-ai-csv-importer
description: AI-powered CSV importer for mapping arbitrary lead exports into GrowEasy CRM format.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/api
